Class Card

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.am23.model.cards.Card
Direct Known Subclasses:
BuildingCard, CharacterCard, EventCard
public abstract class Card extends Object
Abstract base class for every card playable in the game. Defines the shared identity (getId()), the Era the card belongs to, the printed points, and the hooks subclasses implement to react to being drawn and to expose their serializable state.
